description: AlphaFold geometry of the AADACL2 and AADAC N-terminal segments
code:
import requests, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
meta=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/Q6P093",timeout=120).json()[0]
print("AlphaFold entry:",meta["entryId"],"| model version:",meta.get("latestVersion"))
pdb=requests.get(meta["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
ca={}; plddt={}; hel=set()
for L in pdb.splitlines():
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        r=int(L[22:26]); ca[r]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]); plddt[r]=float(L[60:66])
    elif L.startswith("HELIX"):
        try: hel.update(range(int(L[21:25]),int(L[33:37])+1))
        except Exception: pass
print("CA atoms parsed:",len(ca))
core=np.mean([ca[r] for r in ca if r>=60],axis=0)
print("mean pLDDT res 1-20  : %.1f"%np.mean([plddt[r] for r in range(1,21)]))
print("mean pLDDT res 30-401: %.1f"%np.mean([plddt[r] for r in range(30,402) if r in plddt]))
print("res 1-20 in a modelled helix: %d/20"%len([r for r in range(1,21) if r in hel]))
print("res1->res20 end-to-end: %.1f A (ideal continuous alpha-helix over 19 res = %.1f A)"%(np.linalg.norm(ca[1]-ca[20]),19*1.5))
print("mean |CA - catalytic-domain centroid|: res1-20 = %.1f A ; res60-401 = %.1f A"%(
      np.mean([np.linalg.norm(ca[r]-core) for r in range(1,21)]),
      np.mean([np.linalg.norm(ca[r]-core) for r in range(60,402) if r in ca])))
print("min CA-CA distance, res1-18 to any residue >60: %.1f A"%min(np.linalg.norm(ca[i]-ca[j]) for i in range(1,19) for j in ca if j>60))

# same for AADAC (experimentally membrane-anchored homolog) as an internal control
m2=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/P22760",timeout=120).json()[0]
p2=requests.get(m2["pdbUrl"],timeout=180).text
ca2={};pl2={}
for L in p2.splitlines():
    if L.startswith("ATOM") and L[12:16].strip()=="CA":
        r=int(L[22:26]); ca2[r]=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])]); pl2[r]=float(L[60:66])
c2=np.mean([ca2[r] for r in ca2 if r>=60],axis=0)
print("\nAADAC (P22760) control: mean pLDDT res1-23 = %.1f ; end-to-end res1->23 = %.1f A ; min dist to core = %.1f A"%(
      np.mean([pl2[r] for r in range(1,24)]), np.linalg.norm(ca2[1]-ca2[23]),
      min(np.linalg.norm(ca2[i]-ca2[j]) for i in range(1,24) for j in ca2 if j>60)))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.5))
rr=sorted(ca)
ax[0].plot(rr,[plddt[r] for r in rr],color="#3a7ca5",lw=1,label="AADACL2 (Q6P093)")
ax[0].plot(sorted(ca2),[pl2[r] for r in sorted(ca2)],color="#d1495b",lw=1,alpha=.7,label="AADAC (P22760)")
ax[0].axvspan(1,20,color="orange",alpha=.25); ax[0].axhline(70,ls=":",c="k")
ax[0].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[0].set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[0].set_title("AlphaFold confidence across the N-terminal segment (shaded)",fontsize=10)
ax[1].plot(rr,[np.linalg.norm(ca[r]-core) for r in rr],color="#3a7ca5",lw=1,label="AADACL2")
ax[1].plot(sorted(ca2),[np.linalg.norm(ca2[r]-c2) for r in sorted(ca2)],color="#d1495b",lw=1,alpha=.7,label="AADAC")
ax[1].axvspan(1,20,color="orange",alpha=.25); ax[1].legend(fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel("residue"); ax[1].set_ylabel("distance from catalytic-domain centroid (A)")
ax[1].set_title("N-terminal helix projects away from the hydrolase domain",fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
